title: A Hidden Markov Preference Model for Online Prediction of Adversary Actions
abstract: arXiv:2611.08445v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A defender anticipating an attacker needs a probability distribution over the attacker's next action from information available before that action occurs. Two structures complicate this: the attacker's behavioral regime persists and can switch within an episode, and each action combines an operation with state-dependent arguments whose feasible values change over time. We capture both with a hidden Markov model whose latent state is the active regime and whose regime-conditioned action law is defined on a feasibility-masked tree of executable actions. The same likelihood forms the next-action distribution and updates the regime belief once the action is seen, and a partially observed prefix contributes its resolved local factors. Estimation separates into convex logistic fits that Baum-Welch reuses when regimes are unlabeled. translated_title: 用于对手行动在线预测的隐马尔可夫偏好模型
translated_abstract: 预判攻击者的防御者需要在攻击行动发生之前，基于已有信息得到攻击者下一步行动的概率分布。两种结构性因素使这一问题变得复杂：攻击者的行为模式会在一次对抗过程中持续存在并可能发生切换；且每个行动由操作与依赖状态的参数组合而成，这些参数的可行取值随时间变化。我们用隐马尔可夫模型同时刻画这两点：其隐状态为当前活跃的行为模式，而该模式条件下的行动分布定义在一棵经过可行性掩码处理的可执行行动树上。同一似然函数既构成下一步行动分布，又在观察到行动后更新对行为模式的信念，部分观测到的前缀序列则贡献其已解析的局部因子。估计过程可分解为凸的逻辑回归拟合，当行为模式无标签时可由 Baum-Welch 算法复用。我们推导了衡量行为模式信息的可达性加权逐节点 KL 散度表达式，以及关于切换的序列级对数损失上界……（摘要截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种隐马尔可夫偏好模型，将攻击者行为模式作为隐状态、在可行性掩码行动树上定义模式条件下的行动分布，从而实现对对手下一步行动的在线概率预测、信念更新及信息量化的理论保证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a hidden Markov preference model that treats the attacker's behavioral regime as a latent state with regime-conditioned action distributions over a feasibility-masked action tree, enabling online probabilistic prediction of the adversary's next action along with belief updating and information-theoretic guarantees.
